# Vectorization summary (generated by scripts/vec_check.py)

Cell = class/widest vector register in the hottest loop (V=vector, P=partial: packed multiply but serial scalar adds, S=scalar), `+fma` if the loop contains FMA instructions.

Source of truth: objdump of the compiled kernels (reports/<build>.objdump.txt).

## Compiler report (-fopt-info-vec-*): messages per source loop (summed over f32/f64/i32)

`ok/miss` = number of 'loop vectorized' / 'couldn't vectorize loop' messages. Each loop is instantiated for 3 types, and epilogues add extra 'ok' lines. NOTE: GCC reports 'loop vectorized' for the non-fast-math FP dot loop too, because it vectorizes the multiplies but keeps an in-order (serial) reduction - see case study.

| build | saxpy | dot | mul | stencil | saxpy_stride | dot_stride | saxpy_gather | dot_gather |

| sse | 18/0 | 18/0 | 18/0 | 18/0 | 36/0 | 30/5 | 12/5 | 0/15 |
| avx2 | 21/0 | 21/0 | 21/0 | 21/0 | 42/0 | 42/0 | 21/0 | 0/18 |
| znver5 | 21/0 | 21/0 | 21/0 | 21/0 | 42/0 | 35/6 | 21/0 | 7/12 |
| znver5_pv512 | 21/0 | 21/0 | 21/0 | 21/0 | 42/0 | 35/6 | 21/0 | 7/12 |

## Negative example: FP dot-product reduction without -fassociative-math

### sse: dot_f32 -> class **partial**, widest reg xmm, loop: 1 packed arith, 4 scalar FP arith

```
movups        (%rsi,%rax,1),%xmm1
movups        (%rdx,%rax,1),%xmm3
add           $0x10,%rax
mulps         %xmm3,%xmm1
addss         %xmm1,%xmm0
movaps        %xmm1,%xmm2
shufps        $0x55,%xmm1,%xmm2
addss         %xmm2,%xmm0
movaps        %xmm1,%xmm2
unpckhps      %xmm1,%xmm2
shufps        $0xff,%xmm1,%xmm1
addss         %xmm2,%xmm0
addss         %xmm1,%xmm0
[15 instrs in loop total, incl. address/loop-control]
```

### znver5: dot_f32 -> class **partial**, widest reg zmm, loop: 1 packed arith, 16 scalar FP arith

```
vmovups       (%rdx,%rax,1),%zmm1
vmulps        (%rsi,%rax,1),%zmm1,%zmm1
add           $0x40,%rax
vaddss        %xmm1,%xmm0,%xmm0
vshufps       $0x55,%xmm1,%xmm1,%xmm4
vshufps       $0xff,%xmm1,%xmm1,%xmm3
valignd       $0x7,%ymm1,%ymm1,%ymm2
vaddss        %xmm4,%xmm0,%xmm0
vunpckhps     %xmm1,%xmm1,%xmm4
vaddss        %xmm4,%xmm0,%xmm0
vaddss        %xmm3,%xmm0,%xmm0
vextractf32x4 $0x1,%ymm1,%xmm3
vaddss        %xmm3,%xmm0,%xmm0
valignd       $0x5,%ymm1,%ymm1,%ymm3
vaddss        %xmm3,%xmm0,%xmm0
valignd       $0x6,%ymm1,%ymm1,%ymm3
vextractf32x8 $0x1,%zmm1,%ymm1
vaddss        %xmm3,%xmm0,%xmm0
vshufps       $0x55,%xmm1,%xmm1,%xmm3
vaddss        %xmm2,%xmm0,%xmm0
vshufps       $0xff,%xmm1,%xmm1,%xmm2
vaddss        %xmm1,%xmm0,%xmm0
... (12 more)
[36 instrs in loop total, incl. address/loop-control]
```

### znver5_fm: dot_f32 -> class **vector**, widest reg zmm, loop: 4 packed arith, 0 scalar FP arith

```
vmovups       (%rax),%zmm4
vmovups       0x40(%rax),%zmm5
vmovups       0x80(%rax),%zmm6
vmovups       0xc0(%rax),%zmm7
add           $0x100,%rax
vfmadd231ps   (%rdx),%zmm4,%zmm1
vfmadd231ps   0x40(%rdx),%zmm5,%zmm2
add           $0x100,%rdx
vfmadd231ps   -0x80(%rdx),%zmm6,%zmm0
vfmadd231ps   -0x40(%rdx),%zmm7,%zmm3
[12 instrs in loop total, incl. address/loop-control]
```
